description:
Due to a facility emergency, you must immediately close the 'Customer Service Queue' (CS_QUEUE). 

1. Go to Admin > Call Times and create a new Call Time ID 'FORCE_CLOSE' (Name: 'Emergency Force Close') that is closed 24/7 (set Default Start and Default Stop both to 0). 
2. Go to Inbound > Show In-Groups, select the 'CS_QUEUE' group, and change its Call Time to 'FORCE_CLOSE'. 
3. Configure the After Hours Action to 'MESSAGE' and set the Audio Field to 'vm-goodbye'. 
4. Save your changes.
